episodes.title: Shantanu and Ganga
episodes.story: King Shantanu of Hastinapura meets the mysterious Ganga and falls in love with her. Ganga agrees to marry him on one condition: he must never question anything she does.

episodes.title: The Seven Sons
episodes.story: Ganga gives birth to seven sons, but each time she immediately takes the newborn to the river. Shantanu is heartbroken but keeps his promise and remains silent.

episodes.title: Devavrata Is Born
episodes.story: When Ganga is about to take their eighth son to the river, Shantanu finally stops her. Ganga reveals the truth and takes the child, Devavrata, with her to raise him.

episodes.title: Devavrata Returns
episodes.story: Years later, Ganga returns Devavrata to Shantanu. Devavrata is now a brilliant warrior and prince, ready to serve Hastinapura.

episodes.title: Satyavati
episodes.story: Shantanu falls in love with Satyavati, but her father demands that her future son must become king. Devavrata learns about this condition.

episodes.title: The Great Vow
episodes.story: Devavrata gives up his claim to the throne and makes a lifelong vow never to marry or have children. Shantanu gives him the name Bhishma.

episodes.title: The Kuru Family
episodes.story: Satyavati's sons Chitrangada and Vichitravirya become connected to the future of the Kuru dynasty. Bhishma continues protecting Hastinapura.

episodes.title: Dhritarashtra, Pandu and Vidura
episodes.story: After difficult events in the Kuru family, Dhritarashtra, Pandu and Vidura are born. Their different abilities will shape the future of Hastinapura.

episodes.title: The Princes Grow
episodes.story: Dhritarashtra grows strong but is blind from birth. Pandu becomes a skilled warrior, while Vidura becomes known for his wisdom and knowledge of dharma.

episodes.title: Pandu Becomes King
episodes.story: Because Dhritarashtra is blind, Pandu becomes king of Hastinapura. The Kuru family enters a new chapter.
